title: Management Office Overview (Desk and Safe Area)
prompt:
1) Function: Provide a forensic-quality wide-angle overview photograph of a management office desk and adjacent safe area for documentation.
2) Scene / Composition: A neutral, documentary color photograph of a small management office showing a desk in the foreground and a closed safe positioned against a wall in the mid-background. The desk surface is mostly clear with generic office items (plain notepad, unbranded pen, loose blank paper, a simple keyring with 2 unmarked keys) arranged naturally; no personal identifiers. The safe is closed with no visible serial number, logos, or branding, and the surrounding floor area is clear. The desk and safe area together occupy ~70% of the frame, with remaining area showing portions of wall and floor for context. Lighting is forensic flash, even and clinical, with minimal shadows and accurate color.
3) Angle & Distance: Angle 20° downward from horizontal; camera distance 2.2 m from the front edge of the desk.
4) Optics & Technique: 24 mm lens, aperture f/8, shutter 1/125 s, ISO 200, white balance 5200 K; focus set to 2.0 m with deep depth of field keeping desk and safe both sharp; mild wide-angle distortion acceptable but straight lines mostly preserved.
5) Mandatory elements: No timestamps, camera labels, case IDs, or annotations visible in-frame.
6) Negatives: No people; no faces; no reflections showing a person; no real names; no readable personal documents; no logos/brands; no official badges/insignia; no real license plates; no weapons; no blood; no explicit content; no evidence markers or rulers; do not write the evidenceId or any case identifier inside the image.
7) Acceptance checklist: - Single wide-angle color photo showing desk and closed safe area in one frame
- Forensic-flash, even illumination with minimal harsh shadows
- Angle approximately 20° downward; distance approximately 2.2 m
- Generic, unbranded office items only; no readable personal information
- No annotations, labels, timestamps, rulers, or case/evidence text in the scene
- Image is sharp across desk and safe with documentary, non-artistic rendering
